title: Atlas File
description: A single physical file in the system, recorded with its technical info and integrity checksum. Every file belongs to EXACTLY ONE asset (assetId) and is never shared between assets; an asset has many files (original, broadcast, proxy, thumbnail, ...). HSM is the system of record for location/tier/integrity; MAM references the logical set. See docs/architecture/data-model.md#15-files.

assetId.description: The owning asset. Exactly one — a file is never shared across assets.

variant.description: Distinguishes multiple files of the same kind, e.g. a subtitle language ('en') or a thumbnail index ('02'). Unique per (assetId, kind, variant).

storage.description: Where the bytes live. System of record: HSM.

status.description: 'quarantined' after a checksum mismatch; 'missing' if the ledger entry has no bytes.

checksum.description: System-generated on placement; re-verified by HSM integrity sweeps.

technical.description: ffprobe-derived: container, codecs, duration, dimensions, aspect, audio channels, frame rate (+ additive fields such as bitrate).

provenance.description: How this file came to exist.

profile.description: MTS profile that produced it, when applicable.

deletedAt.description: Set when purged per policy; the row is retained for audit.
